items.title: Ukraine preparing response to new wave of Russian escalation – Zelensky
items.teaser: Ukraine is preparing a response to a new wave of Russian escalation and is working with partners to secure additional air defense packages and ammunition for F-16 fighter jets.

items.title: Spionage-Verdacht - Kontrollgremium des Bundestags fordert Konsequenzen aus dem Fall Hanning
items.teaser: Das Parlamentarische Kontrollgremium des Bundestags hat die Bundesregierung aufgefordert, aus dem Spionageverdacht gegen den früheren BND-Präsidenten Hanning Konsequenzen zu ziehen.

items.title: Sybiha shares details of talks with UK foreign secretary at Pryluky hospital
items.teaser: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha has shared details of his talks with UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband, which took place at a hospital in Pryluky, Chernihiv Oblast, on 8 October.

items.title: Zelensky, Costa discuss Russian strikes, EU aid, opening of negotiating clusters
items.teaser: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky and European Council President António Costa discussed the schedule for opening the next negotiating clusters on Ukraine’s accession to the EU, as well as an energy package for the winter and further financial support.

items.title: Two 14-year-old boys killed by an explosive device in a field in Sumy Oblast
items.teaser: Residents are being warned that, in addition to constant Russian attacks, there is a risk of encountering explosive devices.

items.title: Verteidigungskräfte melden Treffer auf Signalverstärker des russischen Mesh-Netzwerks im Schwarzen Meer
items.teaser: Die ukrainischen Verteidigungskräfte haben am 7. Oktober und in der Nacht zum 8. Oktober eine Reihe wichtiger militärischer Objekte Russlands, insbesondere einen Signalverstärker des russischen Mesh-Netzwerks im Schwarzen Meer getroffen.

items.title: Ukraine open to restoring dialogue with South Korea despite Seoul’s decision to recall ambassador – MFA
items.teaser: Ukraine remains open to restoring constructive dialogue with the Republic of Korea despite Seoul’s decision to recall its ambassador to Ukraine, Park Kichang, over the situation involving North Korean prisoners of war.

items.title: Zelenskyy: We are preparing our responses to this wave of Russian escalation
items.teaser: Following reports from the Security Service and the President's Office on 8 October, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Ukraine is preparing responses to the current wave of Russian escalation.

items.title: Major internet outage hits Russia after strike on Yandex data center
items.teaser: A major outage has disrupted Russia’s internet segment.

items.title: Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia kills car driver and injures three adults and two children
items.teaser: A car driver has been killed and five people, including two children, have been injured in Russian strikes on Zaporizhzhia on the evening of 8 October.

items.title: Some public transport services halted in Kyiv following metro suspension
items.teaser: Some public transport services in Kyiv have been temporarily suspended on 8 October due to a drop in voltage in the power grid, following earlier disruptions on the Kyiv Metro.

items.title: Ukrainian Foreign Ministry on recall of South Korean ambassador: Ukraine is open to resuming dialogue
items.teaser: Ukraine's Ministry of Foreign Affairs has stated that Kyiv remains open to resuming constructive dialogue despite Seoul's decision to recall its ambassador to Ukraine.

items.title: Oleshky situation shows limits of dialogue between Ukrainian and Russian Ombudsmen
items.teaser: The situation in Oleshky has demonstrated the limits of what dialogue between the institutions of the Ukrainian and Russian ombudsmen can achieve in the context of carrying out a large-scale humanitarian operation.

items.title: 80% of Moldovans say country is unprepared for attack as Russian drones flow into its airspace, but few back NATO membership
items.teaser: A new poll shows widespread concern over Moldova’s ability to withstand an attack, even as only 4% of respondents see NATO membership as the answer. Russian drones have increasingly crossed Moldovan airspace in recent weeks.

items.title: Moldova ready to take in more Ukrainian refugees come winter, Sandu says
items.teaser: "If this winter in Ukraine is as difficult as the whole world expects, we are ready to receive as many people as need safety," Moldovan President Maia Sandu said at the Moldova Security Forum in Chisinau on Oct. 8.

items.title: Südkorea zieht Botschafter aus Kyjiw ab
items.teaser: Wegen eines diplomatischen Streits mit der Ukraine hat Südkorea seinen Botschafter aus Kyjiw abgezogen, heisst es in einer Erklärung des südkoreanischen Außenministeriums, wie die Nachrichtenagentur Yonhap berichtet.

items.title: Kyiv Metro halts train services due to voltage drop
items.teaser: Train services and escalators on the Kyiv Metro have been temporarily suspended on 8 October due to a drop in voltage from external power sources.

items.title: Russian strike on Kyiv store kills three, injures two
items.teaser: Three people were killed and two others injured in a Russian strike on a store in Kyiv’s Solomianskyi district.

items.title: European Council president invites Zelenskyy to EU leaders' summit
items.teaser: European Council President António Costa has invited Volodymyr Zelenskyy to next week's EU summit, expecting two negotiating clusters for Ukraine to open.

items.title: Ukraine's defence forces strike Omsk Oil Refinery 2,500 km from border using upgraded FP-1 drones

items.title: Ukrainian Defense Forces strike Russian Mesh network relay in Black Sea
items.teaser: The Ukrainian Defense Forces struck a number of important Russian military targets on October 7 and overnight into October 8.

items.title: Ukraine’s FM links Russian plague scare to history of cover-ups, from anthrax to Chornobyl and COVID-19

items.title: Ukrainian drones strike Russia's Omsk oil refinery in Siberia, General Staff confirms

items.title: Zelensky to Rubio: There is no diplomatic dead end

items.title: Präsident der Ukraine und Außenminister Großbritanniens gedenken Opfern des russischen Angriffs auf Pryluky

items.title: Russians strike Dnipropetrovsk Oblast with guided aerial bomb, killing two men

items.title: European Commission comments on Kramatorsk strike: Perpetrators and accomplices shall be held to account
